newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's FLS sells defence unit.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's FLS sells defence unit.

text.p: Denmark's FLS Industries said on Monday it had agreed to sell its Nea-Lindburg aviation unit to the Danish Aerotech consortium, in which FLS itself is allied to Lockheed-Martin, Sweden's FFV Aerotech and the Danish defence ministry.

An FLS statement said that as a condition of the sale it would increase Danish Aerotech's equity capital to 90 million Danish crowns from 50 million. There would be no such injection from the other partners, it added.
It gave no further financial details of the deal, which it said reflected the global trend in the defence industry of fewer but larger companies.

The statement added that under the new structure Danish Aerotech would offer a comprehensive range of services embracing product development, production and maintenance of mechanical and electronic equipment for military aircraft.
It would also seek further expansion in its civil aviation maintenance business, it said.
